16.t: Working with data: forces on a plane
q: In which stage are all four forces balanced?
Calculate the resultant horizontal force in stage A.
Describe the motion in stage C, using Newton’s first law.
Balanced forces, so steady speed in a straight line, at constant height.
Explain what is happening in stage D using both pairs of forces.
Drag > thrust: the plane is slowing down. Weight > lift: it is descending. Both fit a landing approach.
